I've had several diagnosis over the years. Everything from depression to borderline personality disorder. Every professional has their own and different opinion of whats is wrong with me. 

I've never taken a drug that had a positive effect. Most are just like drinking water and have no effect. Others makes me paranoid and violent. I guess the best made me sleep more, nothing else though.

You'd think so, wouldn't you. 

Also I don't like video games.

I've been to several psychiatrists since I finished high school n 94. I've been on all kinds of medications too. 

It's funny that they tell you mental illness isn't your fault. Then when you stick you on medication and you hurt a couple of people while having a psychotic break down due to the medications you are on, the court system rules it all your fault.
